description: A user critique of an agentic-AI tool, to be pushed to the tool's GitHub repo as an Issue. See SPEC.md. This schema is the SINGLE authoritative contract for a critique record: the bridge (bridge/push.py), the dedicated adapter (adapters/dedicated/capture.sh) and the ephemeral adapter (adapters/ephemeral/flush-now.sh) all emit and validate this exact shape. additionalProperties stays false on purpose — a field that is not declared here is a bug in the emitter, not something to silently allow. Bridge-compat fields (tool/body/date/user_words/evidence) and queue-lifecycle fields (agent_id/labels/created_at/attempts/next_retry_at, status 'queued'/'failed-held') are declared explicitly below, so the one shape covers both the GitHub issue and the local queue.

attachments.description: Redacted attachments only, included with user approval.

path.description: Local path to the redacted attachment.

redacted.description: True only after the redaction pass.

consent_includes_sensitive.description: True only when the user explicitly approved including a sensitive item; record what was included in notes.

date_wib.description: Capture date in Asia/Jakarta, format YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm WIB.

dedup_key.description: tool_name + normalized symptom, computed at validate time. Same key within 7 days = comment, not new Issue.

model.description: Model in use, if relevant and known.

os.description: e.g. Fedora 42, macOS 15, Windows 11. Use 'unknown' if not observable.

id.description: Local unique id, e.g. crit-20261125-001. Assigned at capture time.

impact.description: One line on impact, user's words where possible.

notes.description: Free-form notes, e.g. what sensitive item the user approved, or why a field is unknown.

receipt.description: Filled after a successful push. Null until then.

comment_url.description: Set instead of a new issue when dedup applied.

repro_steps.description: Only steps actually run or observed. Empty array when none are known.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Bump on any breaking change.

severity.description: Only set when the user stated it. Never agent-assigned.

status.description: Pipeline status. pushed/commented are terminal success; unflushed means the ephemeral session ended before push. 'queued' is the dedicated adapter's on-disk queue state; 'failed-held' is a queued critique after 3 failed flush attempts.

target_repo.description: owner/repo resolved from the registry. Never guessed.

tool_commit.description: Observed commit hash, or null when not observable.

tool_name.description: Name of the tool being critiqued, e.g. codex, claude-code, omp, hermes.

tool_version.description: Observed tool version, or null when not observable. Never guessed.

what_happened.description: The user's exact words (verbatim quote) describing what happened.

tool.description: Bridge-compat alias of tool_name (bridge/push.py minimal contract). Must equal tool_name when both are present.

body.description: Bridge-compat alias of what_happened: the critique body the bridge renders. Must equal what_happened when both are present.

date.description: Bridge-compat date, YYYY-MM-DD, derived from date_wib. The bridge validates this format.

user_words.description: Verbatim user quote used by the issue template. Defaults to what_happened when absent.

evidence.description: Agent-observed evidence (command output, logs, version strings) for the template's Agent-added evidence section. 'None recorded by the agent.' when empty.

agent_id.description: Queue-lifecycle: id of the agent that captured the critique (e.g. hermes, omp). Never rewritten by the flushing agent.

labels.description: Queue-lifecycle: comma-separated labels the bridge passes to `gh issue create`, e.g. 'bug,ux'. Empty string = none.

created_at.description: Queue-lifecycle: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp of capture, e.g. 2026-11-25T10:30:00Z. Used for oldest-first flush order.

attempts.description: Queue-lifecycle: flush attempts so far. Starts at 0; max 3, then status becomes failed-held.

next_retry_at.description: Queue-lifecycle: UTC ISO-8601 time of the next retry, or null when no retry is scheduled.

title: Critique
